method: Executed the real js/spb-ai-knowledge.js and js/spb-self-help.js sources in a fresh Node VM with a minimal app boundary. Queries obtain real helper-offered actions before lifecycle changes. This is a distinct contract from the producer's action/mode tests.

passed_cases: in-place reorder resolves the same zone object to its current index
document replacement invalidates the offered action
throwing callback reports unconfirmed and consumes action
explicit preview callback refusal reports done=false
new non-help input invalidates the old action
when both Chat Studio and Easy body classes exist, Easy takes precedence
Chat Studio Pro HOWTO includes the visible Full editor handoff
Chat Studio selected-zone overview includes Full editor handoff and plain-language in-chat edits

failed_cases.case: same-UUID same-name replacement clone (Undo-like object replacement)
failed_cases.actual: UUID fallback resolves the replacement and toggleZoneMute mutates it, but post-action confirmation searches for the original object reference; runDoIt returns done=false after the requested mutation succeeded.
failed_cases.impact: False negative and conflicting guidance for a safe UUID-resolved action.

async_probe.callback: triggerPreviewRender returned a pending Promise, later resolved false
async_probe.actual: runDoIt immediately returned done=true and 'Refreshing the LIVE PREVIEW now' before the Promise settled; later refusal cannot revise the response.
async_probe.impact: False Done if an installed preview controller is asynchronous and refuses/rejects. Current app callback's synchronous contract was not established by this isolated review.

fresh_async_probe.actual: earlyDone=false; result has pending=true and done=false, with text saying the refresh started but completion cannot be confirmed
fresh_async_probe.verdict: The prior false-Done finding is fixed for promise-returning refresh callbacks.

follow_up_after_producer_repairs.clone_postcondition: Same-UUID/name replacement clone was mutated and returned done=true. The prior false-negative finding is fixed.
follow_up_after_producer_repairs.review_delta: The initial frozen snapshot and findings above are preserved as the before state; this section records the independently verified after state.

scope_limitations: No native app/MCP moved-target proof; parent owns that acceptance.
The packaged mirror hash was recorded but mirror behavior was not executed.
Reviewed only W3 action lifecycle and Chat Studio/Easy help context; the six known semantic misses were explicitly out of scope.
